name: Karnataka Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
department: Department of Backward Classes Welfare
description: Scholarship for OBC students pursuing post-matric education in recognized institutions in Karnataka with annual family income below ₹2,50,000.
benefits: Full reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable tuition fees, admission fee, and monthly maintenance allowance ranging from ₹500 to ₹1,200 depending on course and hostel status.
eligibility_criteria: Candidate must be a permanent resident / domicile of Karnataka state.
Must belong to Category 1, 2A, 2B, 3A, or 3B backward classes.
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 (Category 1 limit is ₹2,50,000; Cat 2A/2B/3A/3B limit is ₹1,00,000 - ₹2,50,000).
Must be enrolled in a recognized post-matric course (Class 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, Degree, PG, Professional).
Must maintain minimum 75% attendance in the academic year.
documents_required: Karnataka Domicile Certificate
Caste and Income Certificate (RD Number issued by Revenue Dept/Nadakacheri)
Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account (NPCI mapped)
SSLC/10th Marks Card and previous qualification marks sheet
College Admission Receipt and College Bonafide Certificate
Hostel Stay Certificate (if staying in college or recognized hostel)
application_process: Applications must be submitted online through the Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) at ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in using Aadhaar e-KYC and student RD certificate verification.
source_title: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Post-Matric Guidelines
detailed_text:
GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA - DEPARTMENT OF BACKWARD CLASSES WELFARE
POST-MATRIC SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME FOR BACKWARD CLASSES (OBC) STUDENTS.

1. Scheme Objective: The primary objective is to provide financial assistance to students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC) studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education without financial hardship.

2. Scope and Coverage: The scholarship is available for studies in India only and is awarded by the Government of Karnataka. It covers students enrolled in government, government-aided, and recognized private unaided educational institutions across Karnataka.

3. Financial Assistance and Benefits: Eligible scholars receive full tuition and mandatory course fees reimbursement deposited directly into the institution's or scholar's Aadhaar-seeded bank account. In addition, day scholars receive a monthly maintenance allowance of ₹500 to ₹750, whereas hostellers receive ₹1,000 to ₹1,200 per month depending on whether they are enrolled in Group A (medical/engineering), Group B (degree/diploma), or Group C (intermediate) courses.

4. Eligibility Criteria: The candidate must be a citizen of India and a permanent resident of Karnataka. Candidates must belong to eligible backward classes categories (Cat-1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B) certified by the revenue authority. The combined annual income of parents/guardians from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum. Students must have passed the previous qualifying examination and maintain satisfactory attendance of at least 75%.

5. Mandatory Documentation: Valid Caste and Income Certificate with 15-digit GSC/RD number from Nadakacheri, Aadhaar card seeded with bank account via NPCI mapper, fee receipt, and student admission bonafide issued by the respective college.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
description: Flagship skill certification scheme enabling Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training that helps them secure a better livelihood and employment opportunities.
benefits: Completely free industry-standard skill training, assessment and certification under National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF), stipend/monetary reward on passing assessment, and placement assistance.
eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen aged between 15 and 45 years.
Unemployed youth, college dropouts, or individuals seeking upskilling.
Must possess a valid Aadhaar card and active bank account.
Must meet course-specific minimum educational qualifications (ranging from 5th pass to 12th/Graduate depending on job role).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card
Bank Account Details (Aadhaar linked)
Proof of Age / Educational qualification certificate
Passport size photographs
application_process: Register online at Skill India Digital Portal (skillindiadigital.gov.in) or visit the nearest Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK) or accredited Training Center.
source_title: PMKVY Official Scheme Guidelines - National Skill Development Corporation
detailed_text:
MINISTRY OF SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP (MSDE)
PRADHAN MANTRI KAUSHAL VIKAS YOJANA (PMKVY 4.0)

1. Background and Objectives: PMKVY is the flagship outcome-based skill training scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. The objective is to encourage and promote skill development for the youth by providing free, high-quality short-term training and recognized certifications.

2. Key Components:
- Short Term Training (STT): 200 to 600 hours of training in National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF) aligned job roles for school/college dropouts or unemployed youth.
- Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL): Assessment and certification of prior informal skills possessed by workers, aligning them to NSQF levels.
- Special Projects: Tailored skilling interventions in government bodies, specialized corporate environments, and vulnerable groups.

3. Benefits and Entitlements: Trainees undergo training with 100% government fee sponsorship. Assessment and certification costs are fully covered by the government. Trainees who successfully pass third-party assessment receive an NSQF-aligned certificate, accidental insurance cover for 3 years, and monetary reward or conveyance support.

4. Eligibility Requirements: Open to all Indian nationals aged 15 to 45. Candidates must have an Aadhaar card and an Aadhaar-linked bank account. Educational criteria depend on the selected job role (Sector Skill Council requirements).

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)
department: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Housing scheme aimed at providing a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and households living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/northeastern states and Himalayan regions, plus 90-95 person-days of unskilled labor support under MGNREGS (approx ₹20,000) and ₹12,000 assistance for toilet construction under Swachh Bharat Mission-Gramin.
eligibility_criteria: Household must be listed in Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC 2011) or Awaas+ survey list of deprived rural families.
Must not own a pucca (permanent) house anywhere in India.
Family annual household income should be below ₹3,00,000 for rural poverty classifications.
Priority given to SC, ST, freed bonded laborers, widows, defense personnel killed in action, and physically challenged persons.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Bank Account details (DBT enabled)
MGNREGA Job Card Number
Land ownership deed or consent certificate from Gram Panchayat
Income/Caste Certificate where applicable
application_process: Beneficiary identification is done through Gram Sabha based on SECC 2011/Awaas+ verified list. Citizens can check enrollment status through their local Gram Panchayat or at pmayg.nic.in.
source_title: PMAY-G Framework for Implementation - Ministry of Rural Development
detailed_text:
MINISTRY OF RURAL DEVELOPMENT - GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
PRADHAN MANTRI AWAS YOJANA - GRAMIN (PMAY-G) GUIDELINES

1. Vision: Housing for All by ensuring construction of quality pucca houses with hygienic cooking space and basic amenities including electricity, piped drinking water, and clean LPG connection.

2. Financial Assistance: Beneficiaries receive unit assistance of ₹1.20 lakh in plain areas and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly states, difficult areas, and Integrated Action Plan (IAP) districts. Payments are transferred directly to verified bank accounts across 3 to 4 geo-tagged construction milestones (Foundation, Plinth, Lintel, and Completion).

3. Convergence Benefits: Beneficiaries are entitled to 90 to 95 days of unskilled wage employment under MGNREGA amounting to around ₹20,000. In addition, ₹12,000 is provided for construction of sanitary latrines in convergence with Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM-G).

4. Eligibility: Families residing in rural areas without a pucca house, categorized under deprivation criteria of SECC 2011 or validated Awaas+ list. Households with motorized vehicles, mechanized agricultural equipment, or government employees are excluded.

name: Karnataka Raitha Siri Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
description: Incentive scheme to encourage cultivation of minor millets (Siri Dhanya) by providing direct financial assistance to millet-growing farmers across Karnataka.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 per hectare directly credited into the farmer's bank account via DBT in two installments, up to a maximum ceiling of 2 hectares.
eligibility_criteria: Must be a resident farmer of Karnataka.
Must own agricultural land in Karnataka with registered Pahani/RTC in Bhoomi portal.
Must cultivate designated minor millets (Foxtail, Little, Kodo, Proso, Barnyard, Brown top millets).
Land holding must be up to 5 acres for small and marginal category priority.
documents_required: Farmer ID (FID) generated through Fruits Karnataka portal
Pahani / RTC Document from Bhoomi system
Aadhaar Card linked with bank account
Bank Passbook copy
application_process: Register land and crop details at local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) or online via FRUITS portal (fruits.karnataka.gov.in).
source_title: Raitha Siri Millet Cultivation Assistance - Karnataka Agriculture Dept
detailed_text:
DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE - GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
RAITHA SIRI SCHEME - PROMOTION OF MILLETS (SIRI DHANYA)

1. Objectives: To increase the area under minor millet cultivation in dryland agro-climatic zones of Karnataka, enhance the income of dryland farmers, and promote nutritional security among the populace.

2. Incentives: Eligible farmers receive direct benefit transfer of ₹10,000 per hectare (max 2 hectares) for growing specified minor millets including Navane (Foxtail), Same (Little), Haraka (Kodo), Baragu (Proso), Oodalu (Barnyard), and Korale (Browntop).

3. Verification & Disbursement: First installment of ₹6,000/ha is disbursed after field verification of sowing via Crop Survey mobile app. Second installment of ₹4,000/ha is disbursed post crop-harvest stage.

4. Conditions: Land must be verified on Karnataka Bhoomi land records and registered on the FRUITS (Farmer Registration and Unified Beneficiary Information System) portal.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for top-ranking students who have scored above the 80th percentile in Class 12 board examinations to pursue regular graduate and postgraduate courses in colleges and universities.
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum for the first three years of undergraduate studies; ₹20,000 per annum for postgraduate studies (or 4th and 5th year of 5-year integrated professional courses like B.Tech/MBBS).
eligibility_criteria: Students must be above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from the respective State Board/CBSE/ICSE in Class 12.
Must be pursuing regular full-time degree courses (not correspondence or distance mode) from a recognized university or college.
Gross parental/family annual income must not exceed ₹4,50,000 per annum.
Must not be receiving any other government scholarship or fee concession.
Must maintain minimum 50% marks in university examinations and 75% attendance for annual renewal.
documents_required: Class 12th Board Examination Marksheet
Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority
Aadhaar Card seeded with active bank account
College Admission Bonafide / Joining Letter with AISHE code of institution
Bank account details (in the student's name only)
application_process: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) at scholarships.gov.in during the open application window (usually July to November annually).
source_title: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship Guidelines - Ministry of Education
detailed_text:
MINISTRY OF EDUCATION - DEPARTMENT OF HIGHER EDUCATION
CENTRAL SECTOR SCHEME OF SCHOLARSHIP FOR COLLEGE AND UNIVERSITY STUDENTS (CSSS)

1. Scheme Purpose: To provide financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.

2. Quota & Allocation: A total of 82,000 scholarships are awarded nationwide each year (41,000 for boys and 41,000 for girls). Scholarships are apportioned among state boards based on the population of the 18-25 age cohort in the respective state.

3. Financial Entitlement: Rate of scholarship is ₹12,000 per annum at graduation level for the first 3 years and ₹20,000 per annum at post-graduation level. For professional courses such as Engineering or Medicine, ₹20,000 per annum is paid in the 4th and 5th year.

4. Eligibility Criteria: Students must have scored above the 80th percentile in the 10+2 pattern from respective boards. Parental annual income ceiling is strictly ₹4.5 lakh. The student must not be pursuing distance or correspondence education. Renewal requires 50% marks in each annual examination and 75% attendance without disciplinary sanctions.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education
description: Scholarship aimed at providing assistance for the advancement of girl students pursuing technical education (Degree and Diploma) in AICTE-approved institutions across India.
benefits: ₹50,000 per year for every year of study (maximum 4 years for Degree and 3 years for Diploma) towards college fee payment, purchase of books, computers, equipment, software, and competitive examination fees.
eligibility_criteria: The girl student must be admitted to 1st year of Degree or Diploma level course OR 2nd year of Degree/Diploma course via lateral entry in any AICTE approved institution.
Maximum of two girl children per family are eligible.
Family annual income should not be more than ₹8,00,000 per annum during the preceding financial year.
Candidate must be enrolled in a full-time regular technical programme.
documents_required: Class 10th and 12th / ITI Marksheet
Admission letter issued by the Centralized Admission Authority for Degree/Diploma course
Tuition fee receipt
Family Income Certificate issued by competent revenue authority (Tahsildar or above)
Aadhaar Card linked to bank account
Bank passbook with student name, account number, and IFSC code
Parents declaration certificate stating only 2 girl children in family
application_process: Applications must be submitted online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) at scholarships.gov.in under the AICTE scheme section.
source_title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme Guidelines for Girls
detailed_text:
ALL INDIA COUNCIL FOR TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AICTE)
AICTE PRAGATI SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME FOR GIRL STUDENTS

1. Scheme Background: Initiated by the Government of India to empower young women through technical education, Pragati provides scholarship support to meritorious girls who gain admission to approved technical institutions.

2. Number of Awards: 10,000 scholarships per annum (5,000 for Degree students and 5,000 for Diploma students) plus all eligible applicants from 13 Union Territories and North Eastern states under special quotas.

3. Financial Benefit: A consolidated lump-sum grant of ₹50,000 per annum is paid via DBT. The amount can be used towards college fees, purchase of laptops/computers, books, stationery, or software.

4. Eligibility Criteria: The girl student must be admitted in the first year of a technical degree/diploma program or second year through lateral entry in an AICTE approved college. Annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000. Up to two girl children per family are eligible.

5. Verification: Institution nodal officer and State Directorate of Technical Education verify student credentials on the National Scholarship Portal.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially Abled Students
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Government scholarship to encourage and support differently-abled students to pursue technical education at Degree or Diploma levels in AICTE approved institutions.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of study (4 years for Degree, 3 years for Diploma) to meet academic expenses, assistive devices, books, and living expenses.
eligibility_criteria: Candidate must have a disability of not less than 40% certified by a competent medical authority.
Must be admitted to 1st year of Degree/Diploma or 2nd year via lateral entry in an AICTE approved institution.
Family income from all sources must not exceed ₹8,00,000 per annum.
Course must be regular and full-time.
documents_required: Unique Disability ID (UDID) card or Disability Certificate with minimum 40% disability from Government Medical Board
Class 10th and 12th marksheet
Income certificate issued by Tahsildar or equivalent
Admission confirmation slip and fee receipt
Aadhaar card linked bank account proof
application_process: Register and submit online application through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) under AICTE schemes.
source_title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme Guidelines
detailed_text:
ALL INDIA COUNCIL FOR TECHNICAL EDUCATION
SAKSHAM SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME FOR SPECIALLY-ABLED (DIVYANG) STUDENTS

1. Objective: To provide encouragement and support to differently abled children to pursue technical education without discrimination, enabling their inclusion into the technical workforce.

2. Financial Assistance: All eligible differently abled students admitted to technical institutions receive ₹50,000 per annum. Unlike quota-capped schemes, all eligible applicants satisfying criteria are covered without a fixed upper limit.

3. Eligibility Requirements: Disability level must be 40% or higher as certified by an authorized medical board or civil surgeon. The student must have secured admission into an AICTE-approved degree or diploma program. Family income ceiling is ₹8 lakh per annum.

4. Disbursement: Amount is directly credited into the student's bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) on an annual basis upon successful progression.

name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Financial support for orphans, wards of parents who died of COVID-19, and wards of Armed Forces and Central Paramilitary Forces personnel martyred in action to pursue higher technical education.
benefits: ₹50,000 per year throughout the entire duration of the course (up to 4 years for Degree and 3 years for Diploma).
eligibility_criteria: Candidate must be an Orphan, OR child whose both parents died due to COVID-19, OR child of Armed Forces/Central Paramilitary Forces personnel martyred (Shaheed) in action.
Must be studying in AICTE-approved institutions in regular Degree or Diploma courses.
Family annual income must not exceed ₹8,00,000 per annum (for wards of COVID-19 or Armed Forces martyrs; not applicable to verified orphans).
Must not be a recipient of any other central or state government scholarship.
documents_required: Death certificate of parents or Shaheed certificate issued by competent defense/police authority
Bonafide student certificate from AICTE institution
Class 10th and 12th marksheet
Income certificate (if applicable)
Aadhaar card and active bank account proof
application_process: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) under the AICTE Swanath scheme.
source_title: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme Guidelines
detailed_text:
ALL INDIA COUNCIL FOR TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AICTE)
SWANATH SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME GUIDELINES

1. Rationale: Swanath provides financial stability to vulnerable students who have suffered catastrophic loss — specifically orphaned children, children who lost both parents or the sole breadwinning parent to COVID-19, and children of martyrs from the Armed Forces or Paramilitary Forces.

2. Financial Grant: An annual assistance of ₹50,000 is given for tuition fees, computer purchase, books, hostel and living costs for each year of study.

3. Eligibility: Student must be studying in an AICTE approved technical college or polytechnic. Total family income must be under ₹8,00,000 per year. Verification is performed by the head of the institution and district administration.

name: Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Comprehensive scholarship scheme to support Scheduled Caste students for post-matriculation or post-secondary education to increase SC gross enrollment ratio in higher education.
benefits: 100% reimbursement of non-refundable compulsory course fees (tuition fee, library fee, exam fee) plus monthly maintenance allowance of up to ₹13,500 per annum for day scholars and ₹18,000 for hostellers in professional courses.
eligibility_criteria: Candidate must belong to a Scheduled Caste (SC) recognized under the Constitution of India.
Must be an Indian citizen.
Combined parental/family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum.
Must be pursuing post-matric courses recognized by UGC/AICTE/MCI/DCI/State Technical Boards.
All children of the same parents can be awarded scholarships.
documents_required: Valid Caste Certificate issued by competent revenue authority (Tahsildar/SDM)
Family Income Certificate
Aadhaar Card linked to bank account
Previous year examination marksheet
Fee receipt and college bonafide certificate
application_process: Apply via State Scholarship Portals (e.g. SSP in Karnataka, MahaDBT in Maharashtra) or through the National Scholarship Portal under Centrally Sponsored Schemes.
source_title: Centrally Sponsored Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students
detailed_text:
MINISTRY OF SOCIAL JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT - GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
POST-MATRIC SCHOLARSHIPS TO SCHEDULED CASTE STUDENTS (PMS-SC)

1. Overview: The scheme is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme implemented through state governments and UT administrations with a 60:40 fund sharing ratio (90:10 for North-East states).

2. Financial Support: It covers all non-refundable compulsory fees charged by institutions according to government-fixed fee structures. Furthermore, maintenance allowance is provided in four groups: Group 1 (Medical, Engineering, Management, Agriculture) receives ₹13,500/yr for day scholars and ₹18,000/yr for hostellers; Group 2 (Pharmacy, Nursing, B.Sc) receives ₹9,500/yr and ₹14,000/yr; Group 3 (BA, B.Com, General Degrees) receives ₹7,000/yr and ₹10,000/yr; Group 4 (Class 11, 12, ITI) receives ₹4,000/yr and ₹6,000/yr.

3. Eligibility Requirements: Student must belong to Scheduled Caste. Total family annual income cannot exceed ₹2.50 lakh. The scholarship is awarded for post-matriculation studies in India only.

name: Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
department: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe students studying at post-matriculation level to encourage completion of higher education.
benefits: Full reimbursement of mandatory tuition and examination fees plus monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month for hostellers and ₹550/month for day scholars, plus study tour and thesis typing allowances.
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must belong to a Scheduled Tribe (ST) recognized in their state of domicile.
Total family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum.
Must be enrolled in a recognized institution for post-matric studies.
Only two children of the same family are eligible (condition relaxed for girls).
documents_required: Scheduled Tribe (ST) Certificate
Income Certificate from competent authority
Aadhaar card with NPCI mapping
Educational qualification marks cards
College fee structure and admission letter
application_process: Apply via State Scholarship Portals or National Scholarship Portal (NSP) under Ministry of Tribal Affairs.
source_title: National Scheme for Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
detailed_text:
MINISTRY OF TRIBAL AFFAIRS - GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
POST MATRIC SCHOLARSHIP FOR ST STUDENTS

1. Scheme Purpose: Empowering tribal communities through higher education by offsetting educational expenses and living costs.

2. Financial Coverage: Complete tuition and examination fees reimbursed. Monthly living stipend categorized across professional, diploma, and intermediate courses. Additional allowances available for books, thesis completion, and disability readers.

3. Eligibility: Tribe certificate issued by competent authority, annual income under ₹2.50 lakh, and regular attendance in recognized college or university.

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
department: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Ministry of Science and Technology
description: Prestigious national scholarship to attract meritorious youth to study natural and basic sciences at the undergraduate and integrated postgraduate levels.
benefits: ₹80,000 per annum (₹60,000 as annual cash scholarship of ₹5,000/month, plus ₹20,000 summer research project mentorship grant per year).
eligibility_criteria: Students who are within the top 1% rank in Class 12 board examination (State Board, CBSE, or ICSE).
OR students securing ranks in JEE (Advanced) top 10,000, NEET top 10,000, or clearing KVPY, NTSE, or International Science Olympiad medalists.
Must be pursuing regular Bachelor’s or Integrated Master’s programs in Natural & Basic Sciences (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Statistics, Geology, Astrophysics, etc.).
Students enrolled in Engineering, Medicine, Pharmacy, or applied sciences are NOT eligible.
documents_required: Class 12th Board Marksheet and Passing Certificate
Class 10th Certificate for Date of Birth verification
Endorsement Certificate signed by the Head of Institution (College/University)
Competitive exam scorecard (JEE/NEET/Olympiad if applying via that channel)
SBI Bank Account details in the student's name only
application_process: Apply online at the official INSPIRE portal: online-inspire.gov.in. No offline applications are accepted.
source_title: INSPIRE SHE Guidelines - Department of Science & Technology
detailed_text:
DEPARTMENT OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY - GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
INNOVATION IN SCIENCE PURSUIT FOR INSPIRED RESEARCH (INSPIRE) - SHE COMPONENT

1. Scheme Overview: Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research (INSPIRE) is a flagship program of DST to attract young talent to the excitement of creative pursuit of science.

2. Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE): SHE offers 10,000 scholarships annually of ₹80,000 each for students aged 17–22 years undertaking B.Sc., B.S., and Int. M.Sc./M.S. in natural and basic sciences.

3. Financial Details: Total value ₹80,000/year. Cash component of ₹60,000 is directly transferred to the scholar's bank account. Additional ₹20,000 mentorship grant is reimbursed upon undertaking a mandatory summer research project under a recognized scientist or research institution in India or abroad.

4. Eligibility Requirements: Must be within top 1% cut-off in 12th board exams or top rankers in national competitive exams. Must pursue 18 specified basic science disciplines. Engineering and medical degree students are excluded.

name: AICTE Post Graduate (PG) Scholarship for GATE/CEED Qualified Students
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Financial assistance to GATE/CEED qualified students admitted to full-time Master of Engineering (M.E.), Master of Technology (M.Tech), Master of Architecture (M.Arch), or Master of Design (M.Des) programs in AICTE approved institutions.
benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹12,400 per month for 24 months (duration of the PG course) or till the completion of the course, whichever is earlier.
eligibility_criteria: Candidate must have a valid GATE or CEED scorecard at the time of admission.
Must be admitted as a full-time regular student in an AICTE approved college or university department.
Candidates admitted through sponsored quota or management quota are NOT eligible.
Candidate must not be in receipt of any salary, fellowship, or other financial assistance.
Scholars must undertake 8 to 10 hours per week of teaching/laboratory assistance work assigned by the institute.
documents_required: Valid GATE / CEED Scorecard
Admission confirmation slip and fee receipt
Aadhaar card linked to bank account (single account only, joint accounts not accepted)
Category certificate (if applicable)
Institute verification letter
application_process: Register on the AICTE PG scholarship portal (pgscholarship.aicte-india.org) with Student ID generated by the admitting institute.
source_title: AICTE Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme Guidelines
detailed_text:
ALL INDIA COUNCIL FOR TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AICTE)
AICTE POST GRADUATE (PG) SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME

1. Scheme Scope: AICTE awards PG Scholarships to full-time GATE/CEED qualified students admitted to Master’s programs in engineering, technology, architecture, and design.

2. Financial Grant: ₹12,400 per month for a maximum period of 24 months. No contingency or book grant is admissible.

3. Terms & Conditions: Students must maintain satisfactory academic progress and minimum 75% attendance. They must not take up any paid employment or private tuition during the course. Students are expected to complete 8-10 hours weekly of academic teaching or lab assistance.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme to award scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop-out at Class 8 and encourage them to continue education at secondary stage.
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) from Class 9 to Class 12 in government, government-aided, and local body schools.
eligibility_criteria: Students studying in Class 8 in Government, Local body, and Government-aided schools.
Must have scored at least 55% marks or equivalent grade in Class 7 examination (50% for SC/ST students).
Parents' annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹3,50,000 per annum.
Must qualify the State-level National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship selection test (MAT and SAT exams).
Students of Kendriya Vidyalayas, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas, and private residential schools are NOT eligible.
documents_required: Class 7th Marksheet / Progress Card
Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority
Caste / Category Certificate
Aadhaar Card and Bank Account in the student's name
NMMSS State Selection Examination Roll Number
application_process: Appear for the State NMMSS selection exam in Class 8. Selected students must register and claim scholarship on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
source_title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme Guidelines
detailed_text:
MINISTRY OF EDUCATION - DEPARTMENT OF SCHOOL EDUCATION AND LITERACY
NATIONAL MEANS-CUM-MERIT SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME (NMMSS)

1. Objective: To prevent drop-outs of bright students from poor economic backgrounds after Class 8 and support their schooling through Classes 9, 10, 11, and 12.

2. Number of Scholarships: 1,00,000 fresh scholarships are awarded each year across all States and Union Territories.

3. Scholarship Rate: ₹12,000 per annum deposited directly into students' bank accounts via Public Financial Management System (PFMS).

4. Selection Process: Two-tier selection test conducted by state authorities: Mental Ability Test (MAT) with 90 multiple-choice questions and Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT) with 90 multiple-choice questions covering Science, Social Studies, and Mathematics taught in Classes 7 and 8.

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship for Minority Girls
department: Maulana Azad Education Foundation, Ministry of Minority Affairs
description: Scholarship for meritorious girl students belonging to six notified minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) studying in Classes 9 to 12.
benefits: ₹5,000 per annum for Class 9 and 10; ₹6,000 per annum for Class 11 and 12.
eligibility_criteria: Only girl students belonging to six notified minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, and Parsi).
Must be studying in Class 9, 10, 11, or 12.
Must have secured at least 50% marks or equivalent grade in aggregate in the previous qualifying class.
Annual household income of parents/guardians from all sources should not exceed ₹2,00,000 per annum.
Only two girls from the same family can avail the scholarship.
documents_required: Minority Community Certificate / Self-declaration affidavit
Income Certificate from competent revenue officer
Marksheet of previous class passed
School verification certificate signed by Principal
Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Passbook
application_process: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) under the Ministry of Minority Affairs.
source_title: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship Scheme Guidelines
detailed_text:
MINISTRY OF MINORITY AFFAIRS - GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
BEGUM HAZRAT MAHAL NATIONAL SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME

1. Objective: To recognize, promote, and assist girl students belonging to national minorities who cannot continue their education without financial aid.

2. Financial Assistance: ₹5,000 per annum for Classes 9 and 10; ₹6,000 per annum for Classes 11 and 12. Amount is directly transferred through DBT.

3. Eligibility: Girl students belonging to Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, or Parsi communities. Minimum 50% marks in previous class. Family annual income less than ₹2.00 lakh. Two girls per family limit.

name: CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme for Single Girl Child
department: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), Ministry of Education
description: CBSE scholarship to provide financial recognition and incentives to meritorious single girl children who are the only child of their parents and have passed Class 10 from CBSE.
benefits: ₹500 per month (₹6,000 per annum) for a maximum duration of two years (Classes 11 and 12).
eligibility_criteria: Must be the ONLY child of her parents (single girl child without any brother or sister).
Must have scored 60% or more marks in Class 10 CBSE Board examinations.
Must be pursuing Class 11 and 12 in a CBSE-affiliated school.
Tuition fee in the school should not exceed ₹1,500 per month in Class 10 and not more than ₹1,500 per month with maximum 10% enhancement in Classes 11-12.
documents_required: Class 10 CBSE Marksheet
Affidavit on ₹50 stamp paper duly attested by SDM/First Class Magistrate declaring the girl as the only child
School verification form signed by Principal confirming admission and tuition fee details
Bank Account details with IFSC code
application_process: Apply online at cbse.gov.in under the Scholarship portal. Send signed confirmation page and affidavit to CBSE Scholarship branch.
source_title: CBSE Single Girl Child Scholarship Guidelines
detailed_text:
CENTRAL BOARD OF SECONDARY EDUCATION
CBSE MERIT SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME FOR SINGLE GIRL CHILD FOR CLASS X PASS OUTS

1. Philosophy: To recognize the efforts of parents in promoting girl child education and to provide encouragement to meritorious single girl students.

2. Entitlement: Monthly scholarship of ₹500 for two years (24 months) paid via electronic bank transfer.

3. Eligibility Rules: Girl student must be an only child (no siblings). Scored 60%+ in Class X board exams. Continuing Class XI and XII education in a CBSE affiliated school with tuition fee not exceeding ₹1,500/month. Renewal in Class 12 requires 50%+ marks in Class 11 exams.

name: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Post-Matric Comprehensive Scheme
department: Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare, Backward Classes Welfare, and Minorities Welfare Departments
description: Unified single-window electronic scholarship platform of Karnataka that integrates e-Attestation, Kutumba household database, and college admissions to disburse post-matric fee reimbursements and maintenance stipends.
benefits: Complete or partial tuition fee concession/reimbursement, hostel accommodation fee (Vidyasiri/OBC hostel stipend of ₹1,500/month), examination fee reimbursement, and special study kit allowances.
eligibility_criteria: Karnataka domicile student.
Enrolled in a recognized post-matric course in an institution registered with Karnataka Higher Education / Technical Education.
Family income within department thresholds (SC/ST: ₹2.5 lakh to ₹10 lakh tiered; OBC Cat-1: ₹2.5 lakh; OBC 2A/3A/3B: ₹1 lakh - ₹2.5 lakh; Minorities: ₹2 lakh).
Kutumba Family ID and Aadhaar e-KYC mandatory.
documents_required: Kutumba Family ID
Aadhaar Number and Aadhaar Consent
Caste & Income Certificate RD Number (from Revenue Dept Nadakacheri)
Fee Receipt and College Bonafide
Disability Certificate UDID (if applicable)
Hostel registration certificate
application_process: Complete e-Attestation of documents via eattestation.karnataka.gov.in, then submit application on ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in.
source_title: Karnataka SSP Post-Matric User Manual & Guidelines
detailed_text:
GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA - E-GOVERNANCE DEPARTMENT
STATE SCHOLARSHIP PORTAL (SSP) POST-MATRIC PLATFORM

1. System Overview: SSP Karnataka serves as the unified umbrella for four major welfare departments: Social Welfare (SC), Scheduled Tribes Welfare (ST), Backward Classes Welfare (OBC), and Directorate of Minorities. It automates eligibility determination, document verification via e-Attestation, and Direct Benefit Transfer into Aadhaar-seeded accounts.

2. Key Benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement up to government-notified limits, exam fees, laboratory fees, and monthly food and accommodation stipends (Vidyasiri / Food & Accommodation scheme ₹1,500/month for students unable to secure government hostel seats).

3. Verification Protocol: Integration with Kutumba Resident Data Hub for family composition, Bhoomi for land assets, and Nadakacheri for caste/income verification eliminates the need for physical paper submissions.

name: Karnataka Vidyasiri (Food and Accommodation Scheme)
department: Department of Backward Classes Welfare, Government of Karnataka
description: Financial assistance for post-matric OBC/SC/ST/Minority students who could not get admission into departmental post-matric hostels to cover food and accommodation expenses.
benefits: ₹1,500 per month for 10 months in an academic year (total ₹15,000 per annum) directly credited to student's bank account.
eligibility_criteria: Permanent resident of Karnataka state.
Must be studying in post-matric courses in Karnataka.
Must belong to Category-1, 2A, 2B, 3A, or 3B (or SC/ST/Minority).
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 for Cat-1, SC, ST; ₹1,00,000 for 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B.
Student must reside at a distance of at least 5 km from the college/institution.
Must NOT be admitted in any government or government-aided hostel.
Must have minimum 75% attendance in previous and current academic year.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account
Caste and Income Certificate (RD Number)
College Bonafide and Attendance Certificate
Distance Certificate / Address Proof verifying college is 5+ km from home
Rental agreement / Hostel declaration
application_process: Apply through Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) post-matric section under Food and Accommodation option.
source_title: Karnataka Vidyasiri Scheme Regulations
detailed_text:
DEPARTMENT OF BACKWARD CLASSES WELFARE - KARNATAKA
VIDYASIRI - FOOD AND ACCOMMODATION SCHEME (FAH)

1. Scheme Intent: Thousands of rural and poor students travel long distances to cities and towns for higher education. Many fail to secure hostel seats due to capacity limits. Vidyasiri provides a monthly cash allowance so students can pay for private room rentals and meals.

2. Financial Assistance: ₹1,500 per month for a maximum of 10 months per academic year (₹15,000 total). Amount is disbursed via DBT based on monthly biometric or attendance verification from the college.

3. Key Eligibility: Karnataka domicile, minimum distance of 5 km between home residence and college campus, student must not have a government hostel accommodation, attendance must be 75%+.

name: Karnataka Arivu Education Loan Scheme
department: Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation (KMDC) / D. Devaraj Urs BC Development Corporation
description: Subsidized educational loan scheme for religious minorities and backward classes students pursuing professional courses (CET/NEET admitted) like MBBS, BDS, B.Tech, MCA, MBA, etc.
benefits: Soft education loan up to ₹1,00,000 to ₹3,00,000 per year at an ultra-low interest rate of 2% per annum to cover admission and tuition fees.
eligibility_criteria: Student must belong to notified religious minorities (Muslim, Christian, Jain, Buddhist, Sikh, Parsi) or backward classes.
Must be a permanent resident of Karnataka.
Must have secured admission through Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA) / CET / NEET.
Annual family income must not exceed ₹3,50,000 per annum.
Age of candidate should be between 18 and 35 years.
documents_required: KEA / CET / NEET Admission Order
Caste and Income Certificate
Aadhaar Card
SSLC and PUC Marksheets
Parent/Guarantor agreement and salary/income proof
Bank Account details
application_process: Apply online at kmdconline.karnataka.gov.in (for minorities) or dbcdc.karnataka.gov.in (for OBCs) after securing KEA allotment.
source_title: Karnataka Arivu Education Loan Scheme Guidelines
detailed_text:
KARNATAKA MINORITIES DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (KMDC)
ARIVU EDUCATION LOAN SCHEME

1. Objectives: To enable meritorious youth from economically weaker minority and backward class communities to enter premier professional education without crippling debt burdens.

2. Quantum of Assistance: Maximum of ₹3,00,000 per year for Medical and Dental courses; up to ₹1,00,000 per year for Engineering, Architecture, and MBA/MCA courses.

3. Repayment Terms: Loan carries a highly concessional interest rate of 2% per annum. Repayment starts 6 months after completion of the course or immediately upon securing employment, whichever is earlier, in 36 to 60 equal monthly installments.

name: Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS) Scheme for Education Loans
department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
description: Full interest subsidy during the moratorium period (course period plus 1 year) on educational loans taken from scheduled banks under the IBA Model Educational Loan Scheme by students from economically weaker sections.
benefits: 100% government subsidy on all interest accrued during the course period plus one year moratorium on educational loans up to ₹10,00,000.
eligibility_criteria: Student must have secured an education loan under the IBA Model Educational Loan Scheme from a scheduled commercial bank.
Must be enrolled in a recognized professional or technical degree program in India.
Gross parental/family annual income must not exceed ₹4,50,000 per annum from all sources.
Income certificate must be issued by the designated state authority (Tahsildar/SDM).
documents_required: Educational Loan Sanction Letter from Scheduled Bank
IBA Model Loan agreement copy
Valid Income Certificate (family income under ₹4.5 lakh)
Proof of admission in accredited professional course
Aadhaar card of student and borrower
application_process: Banks upload eligible student loan accounts directly on the Canara Bank CSIS web portal for interest claim.
source_title: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme Guidelines - Ministry of Education
detailed_text:
MINISTRY OF EDUCATION - DEPARTMENT OF HIGHER EDUCATION
CENTRAL SECTOR INTEREST SUBSIDY (CSIS) SCHEME

1. Concept: Education loans can create high interest liabilities during study years before students start earning. CSIS waives all interest incurred throughout the entire course duration plus one year post-course moratorium.

2. Financial Relief: The central government pays the total interest component directly to the lending bank, ensuring the student's loan balance when repayment starts equals only the principal amount borrowed.

3. Conditions: Applicable on loans up to ₹10,00,000 taken for professional/technical courses in India. Family income must be under ₹4.50 lakh. No collateral or third-party guarantee is required for loans up to ₹7.5 lakh under CGFSEL.

name: National Fellowship for OBC Students (NFOBC)
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Fellowship scheme to provide financial assistance to Other Backward Class (OBC) candidates for pursuing full-time research leading to M.Phil. and Ph.D. degrees in sciences, humanities, and social sciences.
benefits: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) of ₹37,000 per month for the first two years; Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) of ₹42,000 per month for remaining three years, plus contingency grant up to ₹25,000/yr and HRA.
eligibility_criteria: Candidate must belong to Other Backward Classes (OBC) recognized by the Central Government (non-creamy layer).
Must have qualified UGC-NET or CSIR-NET examination (junior research fellowship qualified or assistant professor qualified).
Must be registered in full-time M.Phil / Ph.D. program in a recognized university or institute.
Total family annual income must not exceed ₹6,00,000 per annum.
documents_required: OBC Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate issued by competent revenue authority
UGC-NET / CSIR-NET scorecard / qualifying certificate
M.Phil / Ph.D. University Admission / Registration Order
Joining Report countersigned by Research Supervisor and Head of Department
Aadhaar and bank account details
application_process: Candidates who qualify UGC-NET/CSIR-NET and opt for OBC fellowship are selected through merit list published by UGC/National Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation (NBCFDC).
source_title: National Fellowship for Other Backward Classes Guidelines
detailed_text:
MINISTRY OF SOCIAL JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT - GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
NATIONAL FELLOWSHIP FOR OBC STUDENTS (NFOBC)

1. Scheme Scope: 1,000 slots per year are awarded to OBC students pursuing higher research degrees (Ph.D.) in Indian universities and research institutes.

2. Financial Emoluments: Fellowship rate matches UGC/CSIR junior research fellowship: ₹37,000/month for 2 years (JRF), upgradable to ₹42,000/month for remaining 3 years (SRF) based on committee evaluation. In addition, Humanities & Social Sciences scholars receive ₹10,000-₹20,500/year contingency; Science scholars receive ₹12,000-₹25,000/year contingency. House Rent Allowance (HRA) is admissible as per central government norms.

3. Eligibility: Candidate must belong to central OBC list, possess valid Non-Creamy Layer certificate, have cleared UGC-NET or CSIR-NET, and be admitted into regular doctoral research.

name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan (PM-USHA)
department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
description: Centrally sponsored scheme to improve access, equity, and quality in state higher educational institutions through strategic funding, modern infrastructure, and student amenities.
benefits: State institutions receive funding for modern laboratories, smart classrooms, student hostels, digital library access, campus Wi-Fi, and subsidized skill incubation labs.
eligibility_criteria: Institutions must be accredited by NAAC with eligible grading.
Covers state public universities and affiliated government colleges.
Beneficiary students are enrolled regular students of supported state colleges and universities.
Focuses on unserved and underserved aspirational districts and remote regions.
documents_required: Institutional registration with AISHE
NAAC accreditation certification
State government project proposal under State Higher Education Council (SHEC)
application_process: State governments submit institutional proposals via PM-USHA portal (pmusha.education.gov.in). Students access upgraded facilities automatically upon college enrollment.
source_title: PM-USHA Scheme Guidelines - Ministry of Education
detailed_text:
MINISTRY OF EDUCATION - GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
PRADHAN MANTRI UCHCHATAR SHIKSHA ABHIYAN (PM-USHA)

1. Objective: PM-USHA is designed to address key issues of equity, access, and excellence in state-managed higher education institutions. The scheme supports multidisciplinary education, skill development, digital infrastructure, and gender inclusion.

2. Key Pillars: Upgrading autonomous and state universities into multi-disciplinary education and research universities (MERUs), building research clusters, enhancing gender inclusion through girls' hostels and specialized disabled-friendly infrastructure.

name: SHREYAS - Scheme for Higher Education Youth in Apprenticeship and Skills
department: Ministry of Education & Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Program offering industry apprenticeship opportunities to general graduates (BA, B.Sc, B.Com) alongside or immediately upon completion of their degree to enhance employability.
benefits: Monthly stipend ranging from ₹6,000 to ₹10,000 per month during the 6 to 12 months apprenticeship period (50% contributed by the Central Government under NATS).
eligibility_criteria: Indian national having completed or in the final year of non-technical graduate courses (BA, B.Sc, B.Com, BBA, etc.).
Must not have undergone prior apprenticeship training under NATS.
Must have an Aadhaar-linked bank account.
Must register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal.
documents_required: Degree Certificate or Final Year Student ID / Bonafide
Class 10th and 12th marksheet
Aadhaar Card
Bank Account details
application_process: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal (nats.education.gov.in) and apply for open apprenticeship contracts.
source_title: SHREYAS Guidelines - Ministry of Education
detailed_text:
MINISTRY OF EDUCATION
SCHEME FOR HIGHER EDUCATION YOUTH IN APPRENTICESHIP AND SKILLS (SHREYAS)

1. Mission: Bridge the gap between non-technical higher education and corporate market requirements by introducing formal apprenticeships for general stream graduates.

2. Financial Incentives: Monthly stipend of ₹6,000 to ₹10,000 paid directly to the apprentice's bank account with government subsidizing up to 50% of the prescribed stipend via Direct Benefit Transfer under National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme.

3. Placement: Apprentices receive on-the-job training in manufacturing, banking, IT, logistics, healthcare, and retail sectors, leading to standard certifications and job absorption.

name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan - Integrated Scheme for School Education
department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education
description: Overarching program for the school education sector extending from pre-school to class 12, focusing on inclusive schooling, free textbooks, uniforms, and digital learning.
benefits: Free textbooks and uniforms for children up to Class 8 in government schools; transport allowance for remote areas; self-defense training for girls; special allowances of ₹3,500/yr for Children with Special Needs (CWSN).
eligibility_criteria: Children aged 4 to 18 enrolled in government and local body schools across India.
Covers pre-primary, primary, upper primary, secondary, and higher secondary levels.
Targeted focus on children belonging to disadvantaged and vulnerable groups.
documents_required: School Enrollment Number (APAAR / Student ID)
Aadhaar Card of student or parent
Disability certificate (for CWSN benefits)
application_process: Enrolled students in government schools receive entitlements automatically at the beginning of each academic session through school headmasters.
source_title: Samagra Shiksha Scheme Framework - Ministry of Education
detailed_text:
MINISTRY OF EDUCATION - DEPARTMENT OF SCHOOL EDUCATION AND LITERACY
SAMAGRA SHIKSHA ABHIYAN FRAMEWORK

1. Vision: Universal, equitable, and inclusive quality education from preschool through Class 12, treating school education holistically in line with Sustainable Development Goal 4.

2. Key Entitlements: Free textbooks and two sets of uniforms to all girls, SC, ST, and BPL boys in elementary classes. Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas (KGBVs) residential schools for girls in backward blocks. Vocational education integrated from Class 9 onwards with ICT and smart class infrastructure in all secondary schools.

name: PM SHRI Schools (PM Schools for Rising India)
department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education
description: Centrally sponsored initiative to develop over 14,500 exemplar schools managed by Central/State/UT governments that showcase the implementation of the National Education Policy 2020.
benefits: State-of-the-art green school infrastructure, smart classrooms, experiential learning labs, robotics and coding labs, career guidance counseling, and full experiential learning support.
eligibility_criteria: Students enrolled in designated PM SHRI exemplar schools across India.
Open to all students seeking admission based on standard school intake norms.
documents_required: Birth certificate
Previous school transfer certificate (TC)
Aadhaar card
application_process: Apply for admission directly at selected PM SHRI schools in the local area or through state school admission portals.
source_title: PM SHRI Guidelines - Ministry of Education
detailed_text:
MINISTRY OF EDUCATION
PM SCHOOLS FOR RISING INDIA (PM SHRI)

1. Concept: PM SHRI schools deliver high quality education in an equitable, inclusive and joyful school environment that takes care of the diverse background and multilingual needs of children.

2. Key Innovations: Equipped with green schools features (solar panels, LED lights, nutrition gardens), modern STEM labs, tinkering labs, dynamic sports facilities, and bilingual pedagogical materials delivering the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020.

name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Fellowship for SC/ST Ph.D. Scholars
department: Department of Social Welfare, Government of Karnataka
description: Prestigious research fellowship by the Government of Karnataka for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe scholars pursuing doctoral (Ph.D.) studies in recognized state and central universities in Karnataka.
benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹25,000 per month for up to 3 years plus an annual contingency grant of ₹20,000 for purchasing books, research materials, and field surveys.
eligibility_criteria: Candidate must belong to SC or ST community.
Must be a permanent resident of Karnataka.
Must be enrolled in full-time Ph.D. program in a recognized university in Karnataka.
Family annual income must not exceed ₹6,00,000 per annum.
Candidate must not be employed in government or private service during the fellowship.
documents_required: Caste and Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority
Ph.D. Registration / Admission order from University
Research proposal and synopsis approved by Doctoral Committee
Aadhaar card linked to bank account
No Objection / Unemployed declaration certificate
application_process: Apply online at swdservices.karnataka.gov.in (Social Welfare Department portal) when the annual notification is published.
source_title: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Research Fellowship Guidelines - Karnataka Social Welfare
detailed_text:
GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA - SOCIAL WELFARE DEPARTMENT
DR. B.R. AMBEDKAR FELLOWSHIP FOR RESEARCH SCHOLARS

1. Purpose: Encourage high-quality doctoral research among youth from historically marginalized SC/ST communities, addressing underrepresentation in higher academic faculties.

2. Financial Assistance: ₹25,000 per month for a maximum of 36 months, with ₹20,000 annual contingency grant. Progress is evaluated every 6 months by an expert university committee.

name: Maulana Azad National Fellowship (MANF) for Minority Students
department: Ministry of Minority Affairs
description: Fellowship scheme providing financial assistance to minority students pursuing regular and full-time M.Phil and Ph.D. degrees in Sciences, Humanities, Social Sciences, & Engineering.
benefits: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) of ₹31,000 to ₹37,000/month; Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) of ₹35,000 to ₹42,000/month plus HRA and contingency grants.
eligibility_criteria: Candidate must belong to one of the notified minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi).
Must have qualified UGC-NET or CSIR-NET examination.
Total family annual income must not exceed ₹6,00,000 per annum.
Must be enrolled in a regular full-time M.Phil/Ph.D. program.
documents_required: Minority Community Certificate / Self-Declaration
Valid Income Certificate
UGC-NET / CSIR-NET Scorecard
Ph.D. Admission / Registration letter
Bank Account details (DBT enabled)
application_process: Administered via UGC / Ministry of Minority Affairs portal for NET-qualified minority researchers.
source_title: Maulana Azad National Fellowship Guidelines
detailed_text:
MINISTRY OF MINORITY AFFAIRS - GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
MAULANA AZAD NATIONAL FELLOWSHIP FOR MINORITY STUDENTS

1. Scheme Scope: Provides 5-year financial support to minority community researchers to attain doctoral qualifications without financial strain.

2. Emoluments: Equivalent to UGC/CSIR Junior and Senior Research Fellowships, with contingency allowances for research equipment and field travel.
